ICE has been killing people continuously. 

We cannot forget that most of these people (between 70% and 90%) have never been charged with a crime. The worst infraction ICE has jurisdiction over is a misdemeanor. Their other main enforcement area is a civil infraction, not crime.

People. Are. Dying.
